svg.title: Create an account for someone, as a site admin — SoftTrack web design mockup (#303)
svg.desc: An account comes into being when its owner registers, so a new hire’s account cannot be prepared before they arrive. A site admin creates the account with a name, an email and where the person belongs; the account has no password; and the person gets a link to choose one, from the machinery password reset uses.

· a door that is not registration
An account, prepared before its owner arrives

svg.text: A link to choose a password

g.text: An account was made for you at Northwind. Choose a
password to sign in. The link works once, until 6 October.

svg.text: Done when a site admin can create an account with name, email and username and optionally department, manager, start date, title and teams; the account has no password and
its owner gets a single-use link to choose one; without SMTP the admin copies the link; the account can be assigned work and mentioned and is marked as not yet activated; it
works with open registration off and is not counted by the registration rate limit; and the link can be sent again.
